info.headline: Moderate Flood Warning for Balonne River to Surat, Balonne River at Warkon and Balonne River at Surat
info.description:
Minor flooding is occurring along the Balonne River to Surat. Moderate flooding is likely at Surat.
The Balonne River at Warkon peaked at 8.47 m around 03:00 pm Friday, with moderate flooding. The river is currently at 7.92 m and falling, with minor flooding. The Balonne River at Warkon may remain above the minor flood level (7.00 m) for the remainder of Saturday into Sunday.
No observations are currently available for the Balonne River at Surat. Based on the nearby Surat TM gauge, river levels are estimated to be above the minor flood level (5.00 m) and rising. The Balonne River at Surat is likely to exceed the moderate flood level (7.00 m) overnight Saturday into Sunday. The river may peak near 7.40 m Sunday morning, with moderate flooding.
info.instruction:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous. * Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways. * Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads. * Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed. * For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.
For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.
